protocol.reference: Common original 3DGS render, no edited ground truth
protocol.mask: Reviewed common physical target, with 9-pixel dilation for background exclusion
protocol.clip: OpenAI ViT-L/14; local target bounding box with 20px context

protocol.aggregation: Unweighted mean over valid views/pairs; n reported
